title: Chapter 299 Desert Base
content:
Chapter 299 Desert Base

Naga Desert Main City.

While the Zerg air force was conducting a cleanup operation, a large number of Zerg hosts had already flown into the vast desert in stealth mode, going to explore the surrounding situation and find a suitable location for the Zerg to build a sub-base.

After a quick search, Wu Qing and the Queen Zerg found a more suitable location in the north of the Naga Desert Main City.

The construction of the Zerg sub-base is actually not picky about the environment. The main consideration for choosing the location of the Zerg sub-base is the distance from all forces.

Of course, it would be better if there are abundant resources underground.

Because Wu Qing decided to take over this desert, he only had to consider the distance from the Naga Desert Main City. Other desert races were enemies and were all targets for the Zerg to eliminate.

These enemies no longer need to be considered too much for the current Zerg.

Wu Qing suddenly discovered that it might be easier for the Zerg to draw out the seven-star strongmen from the evil god camp to participate in the battle in this newly opened desert battlefield.

Because this place is relatively closed, the impact of the strong participating in the battle will be much smaller.

The Zerg chose the location for the construction of the sub-base. The third detachment of the Zerg air force did not stay in the Naga desert main city, but went straight north and pushed all the way.

Ten thousand five-star Zerg air guards and ten thousand five-star Zerg devourers opened the way, and five hundred thousand one-star Zerg flying dragons cleared the field. Countless soldiers of the desert race army turned into light and disappeared.

Whether it was ground troops or desert eagles in the air, the Zerg army treated them all equally. Those who dared to block the road were all eliminated.

The Zerg air force showed the Naga what a clearing assault is!

The third detachment of the Zerg air force quickly broke through the desert race army assembled in the north of the Naga desert main city, rushed into the wind and sand, and soon disappeared.

Only a pile of debris left on the yellow sand behind them was left.

The desert race army that surrounded the Naga desert main city had a huge gap in the north.

Naga looked at the disappearing Zerg air force and asked Host No. 3 with some concern: "Will there be any problems if they rush out like this?"

Wu Qing told the truth through Host No. 3: "They are going to build a base to attract the troops of the desert race and share the pressure here!"

"The two races can better open up this mysterious desert battlefield by watching each other!"

"Elder, please rest assured, they have brought enough supplies to build a space transmission channel and get support from the tribe. Don't worry about their safety!"

Wu Qing has nothing to hide except that he replaced the construction of the Zerg sub-base with the construction of the space transmission channel.

"In that case, we are relieved!"

Naga suddenly realized that the Zerg seemed to have developed to a height that she needed to look up to without realizing it.

...

The construction site of the Zerg sub-base selected by Wu Qing was not far from the Naga desert main city. After all, he still needed to take care of the Naga tribe, and it would be inconvenient to be too far away.

Wu Qing could see that the Naga tribe only wanted to successfully defend the desert main city for the time being, meet the basic conditions for opening up the desert battlefield, and obtain the rewards of the world rules.

As for planning the entire desert area, the Naga tribe has never thought about it. The power that the Naga tribe can put into the desert battlefield is limited.

If they do not cooperate with the Zerg, they will still cooperate with other large tribes in the local camp in the future to jointly develop the desert battlefield and strive to allow the local camp to occupy a place in this desert area.

Wu Qing could hear from Naga's words that this goal is the long-term goal of the Naga tribe.

Therefore, Wu Qing's goal does not conflict with the goal of the Naga tribe.

The third detachment of the Zerg air force arrived at the destination soon.

Among the accompanying auxiliary arms, there are already six-star Zerg hosts, and all creatures that follow the third detachment of the Zerg air force have nowhere to escape.

All the desert race scouts who followed underground, on the ground and in the air were killed by the Zerg, and the surrounding area became clean.

The seven-star strongmen of the desert race hiding in the dark, the queen gave them a little warning, so that they retreated when they knew the difficulty.

These seven-star masters were very far away, otherwise Wu Qing would have taken the initiative.

The Naga masters followed from a distance, and when they saw the desert masters retreating far away, they stopped following.

Ten six-star Zerg queens flew out and parasitized and controlled all the creatures in the area where the Zerg was going to build a sub-base. Regardless of whether they were intelligent or not, it was always right to control them first.

The parasitic control of the six-star Zerg queen can control the parasites without damaging them, and can also remove the parasitic control without damage.

This kind of parasitic control will not have any effect on the parasites that have gained freedom.

This makes the application of the Zerg queen's parasitic control more extensive.

After clearing all hidden dangers, the transport-type Zerg host put down a large number of Zerg worker bees and began to dig down on the continuous sand dunes below the third detachment of the Zerg air force.

In order to increase the efficiency of excavation, some Zerg workers were upgraded on the spot. With high-star Zerg workers, they could dig out underground space for building Zerg sub-bases in a very short time.

After digging out the floating sand on the outer layer of the desert, the soil and rocks deep underground were not much different from those in other places. The underground of this desert was also a treasure land rich in resources, which was very suitable for Zerg to build underground bases.

The construction method of the first two Zerg sub-bases is still the same. First dig to a depth that even the Zerg hosts cannot detect, then start to expand the underground space, and then build the Zerg mother nest.

This chapter is not over, please click on the next page to continue reading!

Soon, the third Zerg base was established under the vast desert.

In the early stages of the construction of the Zerg sub-base, all Zerg mother nests will hatch Zerg worker bees. When the base space expands to a certain extent and the number of Zerg mother nests is sufficient, Zerg puppies and Type III Zerg poisonous ray scorpions will begin to be hatched.

The Zerg's space transmission channel, the Chrysalis Passage, was also built, connecting the Zerg's newly built third branch base with the Zerg's base camp and other sub-bases.

With the third Zerg base as the center, the Zerg first sent out Zerg hosts for exploration and reconnaissance, and then sent a large number of Zerg puppies and Type III Zerg poisonous ray scorpions to control the known desert areas.

In this ancient desert territory, there is no strange interference, and the Zerg can develop freely without restrictions.

When the third Zerg base in the desert battlefield was basically completed and had sufficient defense system and self-protection capabilities, the third detachment of the Zerg air force returned to the main desert city of the Naga tribe to assist the Naga tribe in combat.

The combat power of the Zerg army cannot be wasted. The offensive and defensive battle for the main city of the Naga desert is not over yet, and it needs support.

A large number of Zerg puppies and type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions have entered the desert battlefield. The main desert city of the Naga tribe should be besieged and attacked by the desert race army for the last time.

The Zerg are a highly offensive race. Once the Zerg base is built, there is no reason for the desert race's troops to take the initiative to attack. Instead, the desert race's troops must gather together and find ways to protect themselves.

The third detachment of the Zerg air force killed a carbine and successfully relieved the danger of the Naga desert main city.

When the Zerg puppies hatched in the third Zerg base and the Type III Zerg poisonous ray scorpions are sufficient, the third detachment of the Zerg air force, more than half a million Zerg destroyers, and the poisonous ray scorpions controlled by millions of Zerg hosts Together with the Naga army and the tens of millions of Zerg puppies and Type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions that came to support, they attacked from inside and outside and completely annihilated the incoming desert race army.

The wind stopped and the sand stopped, and the sky was clear.

After all the desert race armies were wiped out, the wind and sand in the main city area of the Naga desert finally stopped, and everything returned to its original state.

Under the yellow sand, a large amount of loot was buried, as well as the corpses of many desert race army soldiers that the Naga army had single-handedly eliminated.

The battlefield here was all handled by the Naga army. A large number of Zerg puppies and Type 3 Zerg poisonous ray scorpions dispersed in all directions.

The third detachment of the Zerg air force flew back to the direction of the third Zerg base. They needed to rest before continuing the next battle.

More than half a million Zerg destroyers and millions of poisonous ray scorpions controlled by Zerg hosts stayed in the main city of the Naga desert to assist the Naga army in combat.

"No. 3, what are your plans on the desert battlefield?"

Nagaya looked at the leaving Zerg army and asked Host No. 3 with a somewhat complicated mood.

“I don’t have any specific plan, I just fight all the way through!”

Wu Qing replied through Host No. 3.

Wu Qing had to try his best to ensure that the Zerg troops were not idle and could only keep fighting. The strategy in the desert battlefield was similar to that in the demon territory, which was to sweep all the way and force the enemy to gather troops for a decisive battle.

This method is simple and crude, but very useful.

As long as the Zerg army wins the decisive battle, the enemy who can't bear the losses may send strong men to join the battle if they push harder.

As long as there are seven-star strong men participating in the war, the Zerg will soon enter the seven-star era. At that time, no matter what, the Zerg will have to grab the status of the local camp's big clan.

"Okay! If there is a chance, fight side by side with the noble army again!"

Nagaya did not mention that she would discuss with Wu Qing the cooperation between the two races in developing the desert battlefield. She knew that Wu Qing's insectoid branch had been fighting against the Outer Worlds on the public battlefield in the southern war zone and had no time to see her for the time being.

The de facto cooperation between the two tribes has been reached. Other details of the cooperation are not important. What is important is the change in the strength of both parties.

The stronger the Zerg is, the less initiative the Naga will have when cooperating with the Zerg.

…

The third Zerg base in the desert battlefield is getting bigger and bigger. Countless Zerg puppies and Type III Zerg poisonous ray scorpions enter the desert to sweep away the desert races that believe in evil gods.

The desert oases where a large number of desert races gathered were discovered by the Zerg. The third detachment of the Zerg air force was dispatched to cooperate with the ground troops to clear and occupy the desert oases one by one.

Forced by the survival crisis, a large number of desert races got together and, under unified command, began to assemble elite troops on a large scale to prepare for a decisive battle with the Zerg.
